allow_pairs.reason: promote-lesson is the deprecated alias of `lessons promote`, kept for one release; it describes the same operation on purpose

exempt.reason: the /mtk router is reached by typing /mtk; it dispatches to another skill, so an everyday prompt belongs to the skill it routes to
